description: This file defines an Angular component 'TreeNodeDataViewComponent' used for rendering tree node data, including icons, names, tooltips, and chips in a UI tree structure.

classes.name: TreeNodeDataViewComponent
classes.description: An Angular component that visually represents a UI tree node, displaying type, name, optional short name, and chips with tooltips.

methods.name: chips
methods.description: Returns the array of chips associated with the tree node, if it is a HierarchyTreeNode.

methods.name: itemShortName
methods.description: Returns a simplified short name of the node if available, otherwise the full name.

methods.name: itemTooltip
methods.description: Provides tooltip text for the node, unless the name is a Terminal object, then returns empty string.

methods.name: showShortName
methods.description: Determines whether to display the short name based on node type and properties.

methods.name: chipClass
methods.description: Generates CSS classes for styling chips based on their type.
